title: Acceptance evaluation refuses a Markdown-only item's check with "inner command is not a recognized test runner" and no next step
outcome: Acceptance evaluation refuses a Markdown-only item's check with "inner command is not a recognized test runner" and no next step
acceptance: When an item's only check is a non-test command (for example a Markdown link checker run under the focused launcher), the refusal names the check that decided, the observed command, and a concrete supported route for such an item (for example a declared test command or the supported waiver), per the 'refusals explain themselves' rule; shown by a test of the refusal text and route.
No new gate is added and existing evaluation semantics for test-bound criteria are unchanged.
